# AbstractCode

> AbstractCode is a durable terminal TUI for agentic coding on the Abstract* stack (AbstractAgent + AbstractRuntime + AbstractCore). This repo contains the published Python package (`abstractcode/`) and a separate gateway-first web host UI (`web/`).

Important notes:
- The pip package is the Python CLI/TUI. The `web/` app is a separate Node/Vite build (see `docs/web.md`).
- Tools are **approval-gated by default** (see `docs/cli.md`).
- Local VisualFlow runs via `abstractcode flow ...` require the optional extra `abstractcode[flow]` (see `docs/workflows.md`).
- `llms-full.txt` contains a single-file snapshot of the core docs.

## Key code entry points

- [CLI entrypoint](abstractcode/cli.py): argparse + subcommand dispatch
- [Interactive host](abstractcode/react_shell.py): TUI loop, approvals, MCP integration, persistence
- [Workflow agent](abstractcode/workflow_agent.py): `abstractcode.agent.v1` VisualFlow agent mode
- [Local flow runner](abstractcode/flow_cli.py): `abstractcode flow ...` implementation
- [Gateway client](abstractcode/gateway_cli.py): `/api/gateway/*` HTTP client
- [Workflow bundle CLI](abstractcode/workflow_cli.py): install/list/remove `.flow` bundles on a gateway
- [Web gateway client](web/src/lib/gateway_client.ts): browser client for `/api/gateway/*`
